_: Le traduzioni inglesi del catalogo (cielplugin le usa al posto di nome, descrizione e note).

0ad.descrizione: Historical real-time strategy, free and open source.

antimicrox.descrizione: Use a game controller as keyboard and mouse.

bottles.descrizione: Windows programs and games in separate «bottles» (Wine).

xpadneo.descrizione: Better driver for wireless Xbox controllers (rumble, battery).

goverlay.descrizione: Configure MangoHud and vkBasalt with a GUI.

heroic.descrizione: Your Epic, GOG and Amazon games, with Proton.

luanti.descrizione: Free voxel world, with lots of games.

lutris.descrizione: One place for Epic, GOG and Battle.net games and emulators.

prismlauncher.descrizione: Minecraft Java with mods and multiple instances, without the official launcher.

moonlight.descrizione: Stream games from another PC (Sunshine or NVIDIA GameStream).

giochi-prestazioni.descrizione: GameMode (the PC at full power while you play), MangoHud (FPS and temperatures over the game), Gamescope (resolution and HDR per game).
giochi-prestazioni.note: In Steam, the game's launch options: «gamemoderun mangohud %command%».

protonplus.descrizione: Download and update Proton-GE and other Proton and Wine versions.

protontricks.descrizione: Winetricks for Steam games (missing Windows libraries).

protonup-qt.descrizione: Install Proton-GE and Wine-GE for Steam, Lutris and Heroic.

retroarch.descrizione: Classic console emulators in a single program.

steam.descrizione: Valve's game store and library, with Proton for Windows games.
steam.note: Controllers already work (CielOS rules). For Windows games: Steam → Settings → Compatibility → Proton.

sunshine.descrizione: Stream games from your PC (with Moonlight on the other device).

supertuxkart.descrizione: Kart racing, free and open source.

wine.descrizione: Windows programs on Linux, with winetricks.

xonotic.descrizione: Fast arena shooter, free and open source.

localsend.descrizione: Send files to phones and PCs on the same network (like AirDrop).

mullvad-vpn.descrizione: VPN that asks for no personal data.

nextcloud.descrizione: The client for your Nextcloud files.

parabolic.descrizione: Download video and audio from YouTube and other sites.

rustdesk.descrizione: Remote control, free and open source.

warpinator.descrizione: Send files across your home network.

zen.descrizione: Firefox-based browser with tabs on the side.

discord.note: Is the full screen black? Also install «Screen sharing bridge» and share its window; or use «Discord (web)» (like Omarchy). If Discord closes when sharing, turn off hardware acceleration in Discord's settings.

element.descrizione: Chat on Matrix, open and decentralized.

vesktop.descrizione: Lighter Discord, with Vencord and screen sharing that works on Wayland.

zapzap.descrizione: WhatsApp as an app, with notifications.

pavucontrol.descrizione: Per-app and per-device volume, in detail.

easyeffects.descrizione: Equalizer and audio effects for the whole PC.

kodi.descrizione: The media center for your TV.

qpwgraph.descrizione: Wire audio inputs and outputs by hand (PipeWire).

stremio.descrizione: Movies and shows from many sources.

davinci.descrizione: Professional editing and color grading (large: built from the AUR).

gpu-screen-recorder.descrizione: Record the screen and games with the graphics card (even the last few minutes).

obs.descrizione: Record the screen and live stream.

upscayl.descrizione: Upscale images with AI (on your PC).

baobab.descrizione: What is taking up space on your disk.

czkawka.descrizione: Find duplicate, similar and empty files.

dischi.descrizione: Format and check disks and USB drives.

impression.descrizione: Write an ISO to a USB drive.

keepassxc.descrizione: Your passwords in an encrypted vault that only you own.

pdf.descrizione: Evince, to read and sign PDFs.

ventoy.descrizione: One USB drive with many ISOs.

immagini.descrizione: Loupe: opens photos in a flash.

wps.descrizione: Office suite similar to Microsoft Office.

bruno.descrizione: Test APIs, free and without an account.

distrobox.descrizione: Other distros inside CielOS (Ubuntu, Fedora…) in the terminal.

docker.descrizione: Containers, with docker compose and Lazydocker to watch them.
docker.note: Log out and back in for the docker group to apply (no sudo needed for docker commands).

git-strumenti.descrizione: gh (GitHub from the terminal) and Lazygit (git at a glance).

helix.descrizione: Modal terminal editor, ready without configuration.

virt-manager.descrizione: Windows and other systems in a window (QEMU/KVM).

node.descrizione: JavaScript outside the browser, with npm.

podman.descrizione: Containers without a daemon and without root.

python.descrizione: pip and uv (fast environments), for your projects.

vscodium.descrizione: VS Code without telemetry, with the open extension store.

strumenti-moderni.descrizione: eza, bat, fd, fzf, zoxide, dust, duf: the usual commands, nicer.

mc.descrizione: Two-pane file manager in the terminal.

ncdu.descrizione: What is taking up space on your disk.

nvtop.descrizione: The graphics card, in the terminal.

spotify-player.descrizione: spotify_player: Spotify Premium without a browser.

tmux.descrizione: Many terminals in one, that stay open.

samba.descrizione: Share folders with Windows and other PCs.

clamav.descrizione: Antivirus (to check files coming from Windows).

cockpit.descrizione: Manage the PC from the browser.

fail2ban.descrizione: Blocks anyone trying to guess passwords (with the SSH server).

flatpak.descrizione: Flathub apps, isolated from the system.

jellyfin.descrizione: Your movies and music on every device at home.

kdeconnect.descrizione: Your phone connected to the PC: notifications, files, clipboard.

opensnitch.descrizione: Per-app firewall: asks you who may go out to the Internet.

rclone.descrizione: Mount Google Drive, OneDrive and others as folders.

ssh.descrizione: Log into this PC from another one (the firewall opens only the SSH port).

stampa.descrizione: CUPS for printing, with the tool to add printers.

syncthing.descrizione: Folders synced between your PCs and phones, without the cloud.

tailscale.descrizione: A private network between your devices, wherever they are.
tailscale.note: Link it to your account: sudo tailscale up

zerotier.descrizione: A private network between your devices.

web-spotify.descrizione: Spotify's web player, in its own window.

web-whatsapp.descrizione: WhatsApp Web as a standalone app.

web-youtube-music.descrizione: YouTube's music, in its own window.

aur.descrizione: Apps from the Arch User Repository. Careful: they are community recipes, Arch does not check them.

btrfs-assistant.descrizione: Snapshots and subvolumes with a GUI.

corectrl.descrizione: Profiles for AMD CPUs and graphics cards (clocks, fans, power).

envycontrol.descrizione: Laptops with two graphics cards: integrated, hybrid or dedicated.

gearlever.descrizione: AppImages in the app menu, with updates.

lact.descrizione: Control the graphics card (AMD, NVIDIA, Intel): clocks, fans, power.

mission-center.descrizione: Task manager like the Windows one.

nwg-look.descrizione: Themes and icons for GTK apps.

ollama.descrizione: The engine behind Ciel's minds and local models, with the right library for your graphics card.

shelly.descrizione: Package manager with a GUI (repositories, AUR and Flatpak).

tlp.descrizione: Longer battery life on laptops (instead of power-profiles-daemon).

web-discord.descrizione: Discord in the browser, like Omarchy: calls and screen sharing work on Wayland too.

xwaylandvideobridge.descrizione: For the official Discord and other X11 apps: lets them see Wayland screens and windows (otherwise sharing is black). In Discord share the «Wayland to X11 Video Bridge» window and pick the screen in Hyprland's dialog.
